description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_3DPrint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3dprint-custom-model">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Instruction" name="Instruction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeRequest" name="Change request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProjectSTL" name="Artist result (STL)"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instruction" name="Instruction" sourceRef="Task_Instruct" targetRef="Participant_Artist" messageRef="Message_Instruction"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Result" name="Artist result (STL)" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Event_ReceiveResult" messageRef="Message_ProjectSTL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangeRequest" name="Change request" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Participant_Artist" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangedResult" name="Artist result (STL)" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Event_ReceiveChangedResult" messageRef="Message_ProjectSTL"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CraveModel" name="Craving a custom 3D model"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Instruct" name="Instruct artist to create project" messageRef="Message_Instruction"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveResult" name="Artist result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReceiveResult" messageRef="Message_ProjectSTL"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Result"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with result?" default="Flow_ChangeRequest"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell him what to change" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveChangedResult" name="Artist result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReceiveChangedResult" messageRef="Message_ProjectSTL"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_InStock" name="Color in stock at home?" default="Flow_NotInStock"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check how much color you have left"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Amount" name="Less than 100 g left?" default="Flow_AmountOk"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic color"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Plastic"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Split_Prep" name="Prepare printing"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on printer"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Split_Heat" name="Heating up"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatUp" name="Heat up bed and extruder"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate gcode file from STL"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Join_Prep" name="Preparation complete"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ModelPrinted" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="Start_CraveModel" targetRef="Task_Instruct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instructed" sourceRef="Task_Instruct" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SketchesSent" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Event_ReceiveResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResultReceived" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveResult" targetRef="Merge_Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChangedResultReceived" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveChangedResult" targetRef="Merge_Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review" sourceRef="Merge_Result" targetRef="GW_Satisfied"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChangeRequest" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChangesSent" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Event_ReceiveChangedResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorChosen" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="GW_InStock"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_InStock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inStock == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="No" sourceRef="GW_InStock" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AmountChecked" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="GW_Amount"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below100g" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Amount" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amountBelow100g == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AmountOk" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Amount" targetRef="Merge_Plastic"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShoppingListAdded" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Merge_Plastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ordered" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Merge_Plastic"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlasticReady" sourceRef="Merge_Plastic" targetRef="Split_Prep"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TurnOn" sourceRef="Split_Prep" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Generate" sourceRef="Split_Prep" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HeatUpStart" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Split_Heat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HeatUp" sourceRef="Split_Heat" targetRef="Task_HeatUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusWait" sourceRef="Split_Heat" targetRef="Event_PrinterStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrinterReady" sourceRef="Task_HeatUp" targetRef="Join_Prep"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusReceived" sourceRef="Event_PrinterStatus" targetRef="Join_Prep"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GcodeReady" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Join_Prep"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Print" sourceRef="Join_Prep" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Printed" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_ModelPrinted"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
